**Irish ports with 10,000 – 100,000 passenger visits in both 2022 and 2023**

| Port | 2022 passengers | 2023 passengers |
|------|----------------|----------------|
| Killybegs | 11,146 | 27,910 |
| Waterford | 21,276 | 17,054 |

These two ports are the only ones whose passenger‑visit counts fall within the 10,000‑100,000 range for **both** years, as recorded in the CSO release “Statistics of Port Traffic Q4 and Year 2023” (Table 6: Number of cruise ships and passengers by port, 2022‑2023) 【source](https://www.cso.ie/en/releasesandpublications/ep/p-spt/statisticsofporttrafficq4andyear2023/).
